after_proper.name: Prayer after Communion
after_proper.text: Deus, qui illuminas omnem hominem venientem in hunc mundum, illumina, quaesumus, corda nostra gratiae tuae splendore, ut digna ac placita maiestati tuae cogitare semper, et te sincere diligere valeamus. Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
after_proper.notes: Complete1970 source-local prayer independently sourced from the1862 petition and short conclusion. Project study English; current2008 target correspondence remains unresolved. Historical1862 prayer ends Per Dominum; that source quotation remains intact in its own artifact. This derived execution uses actual1970 Per Christum cue,IGMR32 short branch andIGMR122 response placement. The people response Amen is separate.

translations.text: O God, who enlighten everyone coming into this world, illuminate our hearts, we pray, with the splendor of your grace, so that we may always think what is worthy and pleasing to your majesty, and love you sincerely. Through Christ our Lord.
